Yes. Depending on what you mean by **"basic permissions"**, there are two ways to set this up:

### 1. Auto-approve file edits only (Recommended)
If you want the agent to edit notes and files without asking, but still want Obsidian to prompt you before dangerous operations (like terminal/shell commands), configure Gemini CLI's approval mode:

* In Obsidian, go to **Settings** → **Agent Console** → **Agents** → **Gemini CLI**.
* In the **Arguments** field, add:
  ```text
  --approval-mode=auto_edit
  ```
* Alternatively, if you want full unattended execution for all tools including shell commands, you can pass `--approval-mode=yolo` (or `-y`).

### 2. Auto-approve all permissions plugin-wide
If you want the Agent Console plugin to automatically approve **every** permission prompt regardless of the agent:

* In Obsidian, go to **Settings** → **Agent Console**.
* Scroll down to the **Permissions** section.
* Toggle on **Auto-allow permissions** (`autoAllowPermissions`).

> [!warning]
> Auto-allowing all permissions gives agents unrestricted access to execute shell commands and modify vault files without confirmation.
